The original contributor describes the northeastern shore and personally recalls a sexual encounter with a French visitor during a holiday, but gives no date at all. Greece's national visitor agency independently confirms that this beach is on Milos near the island's airport, with family use, camping and watersports elsewhere along the sands. None of this establishes cruising since November 2025.

records.description_rewritten: Frangias (also spelled Frangia or Fragia) is a secluded natural beach on eastern Mykonos, away from the busiest south coast strips. A Greek regional travel directory confirms it as a quiet, undeveloped sandy inlet with a walking path and clothing-optional beachgoing, while a German travel site describes a rocky approach taking roughly half an hour. Its inclusion on the original cruising city index alone does not verify actual recent meetings. Unlike Elia, this beach has no organised scene or regular facilities documented.
